title: Modern ViT (2025): DynamicTanh, 2D RoPE, Sub-Quadratic Attention, and Production Training
description: Full walkthrough of a state-of-the-art Vision Transformer: DynamicTanh normalization (Meta 2025), 2D Rotary Position Embeddings, alternating linear and flash attention (L2ViT), 2D token shift, depthwise conv bypass, and a complete production training pipeline achieving ~85% on CIFAR-10 in under 35 seconds per epoch.
venue: Synthesis: DyT arXiv:2503.10622 · L2ViT arXiv:2501.16182 · RoPE arXiv:2104.09864
